description:
Everything ROCm/HIP: the java.lang.foreign runtime (HIPRTC compile + dispatch,
    no JNI, no native jar), the tensor ComputeBackend, and the replay engine — the recorded
    tape becomes a fused forward+adjoint HIP kernel, HIPRTC-compiled once, replayed one
    scenario per work-item. Mirrors the CUDA module for AMD devices; gates at runtime.
